description: This file generates and writes a JSON catalog of official channel information for extensions within a project. It scans extension directories for package.json files, extracts metadata related to the OpenClaw channels, and writes the catalog if invoked directly.

methods.name: isRecord
methods.description: Checks if a value is a non-null object and not an array.

methods.name: trimString
methods.description: Trims whitespace from a string, or returns an empty string for non-string inputs.

methods.name: toCatalogInstall
methods.description: Extracts installation info from a manifest, falling back to packageName if needed, and returns an install object or null.

methods.name: buildCatalogEntry
methods.description: Creates a catalog entry object from a package.json file if it meets criteria (has necessary openclaw manifest, release info, and publishToNpm).

methods.name: buildOfficialChannelCatalog
methods.description: Builds the full catalog by reading extension directories, parsing package.json files, and aggregating valid entries.

methods.name: writeOfficialChannelCatalog
methods.description: Generates and writes the official channel catalog JSON file to disk.
